data.text: Implementation is on fix/metrics-trace-capture; user authorized one shared PR. Repository inspection found the existing test-support/dispatch.rs workaround (OFF-filtered sentinel with bootstrap regression), so metrics ordering now reuses that constructor rather than adding another sentinel. Both original ordering assertions are exercised in fresh child processes after subscriber-less first touch. A mutation bypassing the constructor failed both at the expected missing WARN/INFO assertions; the initial fixed metrics suite passed 31 tests. Existing destructor-panic assertions remain. No production API/dependency changes. Full verify.sh is running; its initial Clippy pass rejected a new private boolean argument under the repository zero-boolean-parameter policy. Replaced it with CaptureDestruction and restarted verification; no lint relaxation.
